chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi, from Al-Abbas ibn Amir, from Sayf ibn Umira, from Abd al-Rahman al-Arzami, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'A man was found with a man during the emirate of Umar, so one of them fled and the other was seized. He was brought to Umar, who said to the people, "What do you think?" This one said, "Do this," and that one said, "Do this." Then he said, "What do you say, O Abu al-Hasan?" He said, "Strike his neck," so they struck his neck.'

He said: 'Then he intended to have him carried away, so he said, "Wait! There still remains something from his Hadd (penalty)." He said, "What remains?" He said, "Call for firewood." So Umar called for firewood, and Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) ordered him to be incinerated with it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the complete Hadd penalty for sodomy according to Imam Ali (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the jurisprudential debate between the Caliphate and Imam Ali (AS) regarding the sufficiency of beheading for sodomy (*Liwat*). While Umar deemed beheading sufficient, Imam Ali argued that the full *Hadd* requires burning with fire, a view that underscores the Shia emphasis on the completeness of divine punishment as distinct from administrative discretion.
